The '02' is a genuine chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), confirmed as table slot index 1 in data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table at 0x51D71 (preceded by 0x3231b=chapter_01_init, followed by 0x32e8c=chapter_03_init). Not an address residual (function is at 0x32d18, unrelated to '02'). Name accurately reflects role: per-chapter init handler dispatched for chapter 2.
purpose: Chapter 2 (羅德鎮 / Rod Town) init handler: a flat chapter-prologue orchestrator that re-inits battle state, plays four dialog pages chained with four cutscenes (event ids 0x9/0xA/0xB/0xC), loads portrait sets 1/2, composites one battle frame, and pans the camera before handing the chapter off to the player.
logic_summary: Dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table[1] (0 direct callers). After the Watcom __CHK(0x28) frame-size probe: fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); pan_cursor_and_window(0xd,0xb); cutscene 0x9; delay 50ms; dialog page 0 (then battle_anim_phase=0); delay 200ms; cutscene 0xA; delay 200ms; dialog page 1 (battle_anim_phase=0); delay 200ms; load portrait set 1; composite_battle_frame(0); delay 200ms; cutscene 0xB; dialog page 2 (battle_anim_phase=0); clear_all_chars_facing(); pan_cursor_and_window(6,0xc); chapter_init_phase_flag=1; load portrait set 2; chapter_init_phase_flag=0; cutscene 0xC; clear_all_chars_facing(); dialog page 3 (no anim_phase reset -- it is the tail); pan_cursor_to_char(0). No char init: chapter 2 starts with party-only carry-over from chapter 1. battle_anim_phase reset after each of the first 3 dialog pages only. In the binary the page-3 dialog call + final pan_cursor_to_char(0) are emitted as a tail-JMP into the shared epilogues of chapter_07_init/chapter_05_init; the straight-line C is the Layer-2 functionally-equivalent reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value. Void side-effect orchestrator (drives dialog/cutscene/portrait/camera subsystems for chapter 2 prologue).
